title: Code For 1
statementMd:
Jon fought bravely to rescue the wildlings who were attacked by the white-walkers at Hardhome. On his arrival, Sam tells him that he wants to go to Oldtown to train at the Citadel to become a maester, so he can return and take the deceased Aemon's place as maester of Castle Black. Jon agrees to Sam's proposal and Sam sets off his journey to the Citadel. However becoming a trainee at the Citadel is not a cakewalk and hence the maesters at the Citadel gave Sam a problem to test his eligibility.

Initially Sam has a list with a single element $*n*$. Then he has to perform certain operations on this list. In each operation Sam must remove any element $*x*$, such that $*x* > 1$, from the list and insert at the same position ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e4b81f4486fb40815e4604649896be611e6c3c0.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png) sequentially. He must continue with these operations until all the elements in the list are either $0$ or $1$.

Now the masters want the total number of $1$s in the range $*l*$ to $*r*$ ($1$-indexed). Sam wants to become a maester but unfortunately he cannot solve this problem. Can you help Sam to pass the eligibility test?

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*$, $*l*$, $*r*$ ($0 ≤ *n* < 2^{50}$, $0 ≤ *r* - *l* ≤ 10^{5}$, $*r* ≥ 1$, $*l* ≥ 1$) – initial element and the range $*l*$ to $*r*$.

It is guaranteed that $*r*$ is not greater than the length of the final list.

## Output

Output the total number of $1$s in the range $*l*$ to $*r*$ in the final sequence.

## Note

Consider first example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/288fbb682a6fa1934a47b763d6851f9d32a06150.png)

Elements on positions from $2$-nd to $5$-th in list is $[1, 1, 1, 1]$. The number of ones is $4$.

For the second example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52e9bc51ef858cacc27fc274c7ba9419d5c1ded9.png)

Elements on positions from $3$-rd to $10$-th in list is $[1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]$. The number of ones is $5$.
statementZhMd:
Jon 勇敢地营救了在 Hardhome 遭到异鬼袭击的野人。抵达之后，Sam 告诉他，自己想去 Oldtown 的学城学习，成为一名学士，这样他就能学成归来，接替已故的 Aemon，担任黑城堡的学士。Jon 同意了 Sam 的提议，于是 Sam 踏上了前往学城的旅程。然而，成为学城的学徒并非易事，因此学城的学士们给 Sam 出了一道题，以测试他是否符合资格。

最初，Sam 有一个只包含单个元素 $*n*$ 的列表。接下来，他需要对这个列表执行若干操作。每次操作中，Sam 必须从列表中移除任意一个满足 $*x* > 1$ 的元素 $*x*$，并在原位置依次插入 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e4b81f4486fb40815e4604649896be611e6c3c0.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png)。他必须不断执行这些操作，直到列表中的所有元素都为 $0$ 或 $1$。

现在，学士们想知道从 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$（下标从 $1$ 开始）范围内 $1$ 的总数。Sam 想成为一名学士，但遗憾的是他无法解决这个问题。你能帮助 Sam 通过资格测试吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*l*$、$*r*$（$0 ≤ *n* < 2^{50}$，$0 ≤ *r* - *l* ≤ 10^{5}$，$*r* ≥ 1$，$*l* ≥ 1$）——初始元素，以及范围 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$。

保证 $*r*$ 不大于最终列表的长度。

## 输出格式

输出最终序列中从 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$ 范围内 $1$ 的总数。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/288fbb682a6fa1934a47b763d6851f9d32a06150.png)

列表中从第 $2$ 个位置到第 $5$ 个位置的元素为 $[1, 1, 1, 1]$。其中 $1$ 的数量为 $4$。

对于第二个样例：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52e9bc51ef858cacc27fc274c7ba9419d5c1ded9.png)

列表中从第 $3$ 个位置到第 $10$ 个位置的元素为 $[1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]$。其中 $1$ 的数量为 $5$。
